title: Utility field service: substation inspection
summary: Sam, a substation technician, does the monthly inspection at Northlake Substation in Plano. Mid-morning dispatch reports feeder 12 out: breaker CB-12 has tripped on a phase B ground fault. Lena, the relay tech, arrives; they find a scorched insulator from animal contact on the CB-12 line side, clean it, fit new wildlife guards, and close CB-12 with dispatch. On the way out Sam finds transformer T2's oil level low with a stain under the radiator, and leaves it open for a crew.
style: Unedited first-person snapshot from a head-mounted wearable camera at eye level, deep focus with everything sharp, no bokeh, outdoors at an electrical utility substation, slightly off-level framing, overcast daylight, gravel ground, chain-link fence, light sensor noise, realistic, no faces in frame (a coworker's gloved hands at most).

issues.title: Feeder 12 out: CB-12 tripped on phase B ground fault
T2 oil level low, oil stain under the radiator

shots.prompt: A white sign mounted on a chain-link fence gate reads "NORTHLAKE SUBSTATION" in large red letters, with high-voltage equipment behind the fence.
shots.note: On site for the monthly inspection.

shots.prompt: Inside a substation control house: a rack of large station batteries with a wall-mounted battery charger above them; a big engraved plate reads "BAT-1"; the charger display shows "129.8 V FLOAT" in green and a single green "NORMAL" indicator light is lit; no red lights.
Side of a large green oil-filled power transformer with cooling fins and an analog oil temperature gauge; a big white stenciled marking on the tank reads "T2".
Side of a large gray oil-filled power transformer with cooling radiators and a round oil level gauge with its needle in the middle of the band; a big white stenciled marking on the tank reads "T1".

Open door of an outdoor gray circuit breaker control cabinet; a white printed sticker label on the door reads "CB-12" in large bold black letters; a mechanical position indicator flag shows "CLOSED" in red and a counter.

Open door of an outdoor gray circuit breaker control cabinet; a white printed sticker label on the door reads "CB-11" in large bold black letters; a mechanical position indicator flag shows "CLOSED" in red.

Open door of an outdoor gray circuit breaker control cabinet; a white printed sticker label on the door reads "CB-12" in large bold black letters; a yellow alarm light is lit and a flag indicator reads "TRIPPED".
shots.edit: change the position indicator flag so it reads "TRIPPED" and light the yellow alarm lamp; change nothing else.
shots.note: Dispatch radioed: feeder 12 is out. CB-12 shows tripped.

shots.prompt: Front panel of a digital protective relay mounted in a control house relay rack; a large engraved label above it reads "RLY-12"; a red target LED is lit and the small LCD reads "TRIP PH B GND".
shots.note: Relay 12 shows a phase B to ground trip. Reported to dispatch, waiting on Lena.

shots.prompt: Looking up at a gray porcelain bushing insulator on top of an outdoor circuit breaker, with black scorch and flash marks on its sheds and a melted remnant of a plastic wildlife guard; a white sign on the steel structure below reads "CB-12 LINE SIDE".
shots.note: Found the cause on the CB-12 line side: scorched insulator from animal contact.

shots.prompt: A gloved hand holding a new bright orange plastic wildlife guard for a bushing, with a second one still in its packaging on the gravel, next to the gray circuit breaker cabinet whose white sticker label reads "CB-12".
shots.note: Insulator cleaned; new wildlife guards going on both line-side bushings.

shots.prompt: The CB-12 breaker cabinet, closed again.
shots.edit: change only the position indicator flag so it reads "CLOSED" in red again and make sure no alarm light is lit.
shots.note: Dispatch cleared it: CB-12 reset and closed, feeder 12 restored.

shots.prompt: The RLY-12 relay after the targets were reset.
shots.edit: turn off the red target LED and change only the small LCD so it reads "NORMAL".
shots.note: Relay 12 targets reset, event record saved for engineering.

shots.prompt: Close-up of a round oil level gauge on the side of a green power transformer tank with its needle down in the red band marked "LOW"; a big white stenciled "T2" on the tank beside it; a dark oil stain on the gravel below the cooling radiator.
shots.note: T2 oil level is low and there's an oil stain under the radiator. Looks like a slow leak.

shots.prompt: A clipboard on a control house desk holding a single printed sheet with only two lines of large bold typed text and nothing else on the page: "NORTHLAKE SWITCHING LOG" and below it "FEEDER 12 RESTORED 11:10"; a pen lies beside the clipboard.
shots.note: Switching log signed off with dispatch.

shots.prompt: A chain-link substation gate closed with a heavy chain and a brass padlock, and a white sign on the gate reading "NORTHLAKE SUBSTATION" in large red letters; afternoon light.
shots.note: Gate locked, leaving site. T2 oil needs a crew tomorrow.
